_note: Curated smallholder agronomy reference. Durations are typical for medium-maturity varieties in tropical East/West Africa and shift with variety, altitude and season. Fertiliser figures are common extension starting points, not substitutes for a soil test or local extension advice.

crops.spacing: 75 cm between rows, 25-30 cm between plants (1 seed per hole) or 75 x 50 cm with 2 seeds per hole
crops.fertilizer: At planting: DAP or NPK 23:23:0 about 50 kg/acre placed below the seed. Top-dress with CAN or urea about 50 kg/acre when plants are knee-high (4-6 weeks). Add manure/compost where available.

stages.name: Germination & emergence
tasks: Plant at the onset of reliable rains (soil moist to 5 cm)
Gap-fill missing hills within 7-10 days

stages.name: Vegetative growth
tasks: Weed at 2-3 and 5-6 weeks
Top-dress nitrogen at knee height
Scout twice weekly for fall armyworm in the leaf whorl

stages.name: Tasseling & silking
tasks: Most water-sensitive stage: mulch or irrigate if dry
Avoid any stress; yield is set now

stages.name: Grain filling
tasks: Keep field weed-free
Watch for ear rots after heavy rain

stages.name: Maturity & harvest
tasks: Harvest at black-layer / dry husks
Dry grain to 13% moisture before storage to prevent aflatoxin
Use hermetic bags against weevils and larger grain borer

crops.spacing: 50 cm between rows, 10-15 cm between plants (bush types)
crops.fertilizer: DAP about 50 kg/acre at planting, or well-rotted manure. Beans fix their own nitrogen once nodulated; rhizobium inoculant helps on new land.

stages.name: Germination
tasks: Plant into moist, well-drained soil
Use clean certified seed to avoid seed-borne disease

stages.name: Vegetative growth
tasks: Weed early; avoid working in the field when leaves are wet (spreads disease)
Scout for bean fly and aphids

stages.name: Flowering & podding
tasks: Critical water stage
Watch for rust and angular leaf spot
Control aphids and pod borers

stages.name: Maturity & harvest
tasks: Harvest when most pods are dry and yellow
Dry well and store with hermetic bags against bruchids

crops.fertilizer: Responds to potassium. Manure or NPK 17:17:17 at about 50 kg/acre 1-2 months after planting on poor soils.

stages.name: Establishment
tasks: Plant clean 20-25 cm stem cuttings from disease-free mother plants
Weed at 1 and 2 months - the crop is most sensitive to weeds now

stages.name: Canopy development
tasks: Rogue (uproot and destroy) plants with mosaic or brown streak symptoms
Watch for whiteflies and mealybugs

stages.name: Root bulking
tasks: Keep weeds down
Plan harvest; roots keep in the ground but quality drops after ~18 months

stages.name: Harvest
tasks: Harvest as needed; process within 48 hours (roots deteriorate fast)

crops.spacing: 20 x 20 cm transplanting, 1-2 seedlings per hill
crops.fertilizer: NPK basal at transplanting; split urea top-dressing at tillering and panicle initiation.

stages.name: Nursery / establishment
tasks: Transplant 14-21 day old seedlings
Level the field for even water

stages.name: Tillering
tasks: Keep 2-5 cm water
Weed and top-dress urea
Scout for stem borers

stages.name: Panicle & flowering
tasks: Never let field dry out now
Watch for blast on leaves and neck

stages.name: Grain fill & harvest
tasks: Drain 10-14 days before harvest
Harvest when 80-85% of grains are straw-coloured
Protect from birds

crops.spacing: 60-75 cm between rows, 15-20 cm between plants
crops.fertilizer: Moderate: DAP about 25-50 kg/acre at planting; CAN top-dress on poor soils.

stages.name: Emergence
tasks: Plant shallow (2-3 cm) into moist soil

stages.name: Vegetative growth
tasks: Thin to recommended spacing
Weed and watch for striga, stem borer and fall armyworm

stages.name: Flowering
tasks: Sensitive to drought; conserve moisture
Scout for midge and head bugs

stages.name: Grain fill & harvest
tasks: Protect against birds
Harvest when grain is hard; dry before threshing

crops.spacing: 60-90 cm between rows, 45-60 cm between plants; stake indeterminate varieties
crops.fertilizer: Manure plus DAP at transplanting; CAN and a potassium source during fruiting. Calcium deficiency causes blossom-end rot.

stages.name: Nursery & transplanting
tasks: Raise seedlings in a raised, clean nursery
Transplant 3-4 week old seedlings in the evening

stages.name: Vegetative
tasks: Stake and prune
Install pheromone traps for Tuta absoluta
Water at the base, not on leaves

stages.name: Flowering & fruiting
tasks: Regular watering prevents blossom-end rot and cracking
Spray preventively against late blight in cool wet weather

stages.name: Harvest
tasks: Pick at breaker/pink stage for distant markets
Respect pesticide pre-harvest intervals

crops.spacing: 75 cm between rows, 30 cm between tubers
crops.fertilizer: DAP or NPK 17:17:17 about 200 kg/acre in the furrow at planting, mixed with soil.

stages.name: Sprouting & emergence
tasks: Plant certified, well-sprouted seed tubers

stages.name: Vegetative
tasks: Hill up soil around stems
Start late blight prevention in wet weather

stages.name: Tuber initiation & bulking
tasks: Critical water stage
Second hilling; remove wilting plants (bacterial wilt)

stages.name: Maturity & harvest
tasks: Cut haulms 2 weeks before harvest to harden skin
Store in dark, cool, ventilated place

crops.spacing: 45-60 cm between rows, 10-15 cm between plants
crops.fertilizer: Needs calcium at pegging (gypsum where soils are poor). Little nitrogen needed.

stages.name: Emergence
tasks: Plant early and at high density - reduces rosette

stages.name: Vegetative
tasks: Weed carefully
Control aphids that spread rosette

stages.name: Flowering, pegging & pod fill
tasks: Do not disturb soil around pegs
Critical water stage

stages.name: Harvest
tasks: Harvest when inside of shells darkens
Dry quickly to prevent aflatoxin

crops.spacing: 2.7 x 2.7 m (arabica) or per local recommendation
crops.fertilizer: NPK after main rains plus nitrogen top-dressing split in two; mulch heavily.

stages.name: Flowering
tasks: Flowering follows the first rains after a dry spell
Keep weeds down

stages.name: Berry expansion
tasks: Spray copper preventively against berry disease and leaf rust in wet periods
Prune suckers

stages.name: Ripening
tasks: Watch for berry borer

stages.name: Harvest & post-harvest
tasks: Pick only red ripe cherries
Deliver to the factory the same day

crops.spacing: 3 x 3 m; keep 3 suckers per mat (mother, daughter, granddaughter)
crops.fertilizer: Heavy feeder: manure/compost every season plus potassium-rich fertiliser; mulch.

stages.name: Vegetative
tasks: De-sucker to 3 plants per mat
Remove dry leaves; mulch

stages.name: Flowering & bunch development
tasks: Remove the male bud with a forked stick after the last hand opens (prevents BXW)
Prop heavy plants

stages.name: Harvest
tasks: Harvest when fingers are full and rounded
Disinfect tools between mats
